value.rationale: Complete natural classification: an arbitrary sequence of b^2 possible forbidden bigrams per time has all of its finite-length survival counts encoded by one precisely recoverable binary overlap bit per time. Exact reduction from b-dimensional transfer products to 2 dimensions is computationally and structurally useful for nonstationary holes; periodic overlap words yield exact algebraic geometric dimensions. The period-four counterexample differentiates temporal arrangement from overlap frequency. This answers a precise motivated counting-invariant question for moving-hole dynamics, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a routine known-table recomputation.
